teacher_architecture_findings.model_paradigm: Discrete Masked Audio Token Generative Model (MaskGIT / SoundStorm style)
teacher_architecture_findings.backbone: Qwen3 Transformer (28 layers, hidden_dim=2048, intermediate_dim=5632, 16 Q heads, 8 KV heads)
teacher_architecture_findings.audio_representation: 8 Discrete RVQ Codebooks at 25Hz (Audio Vocabulary Size: 2048 per codebook)
teacher_architecture_findings.embedding_mechanism: Shifted codebook IDs summed into 2048-dim audio embeddings, masked-multiplexed with text embeddings
teacher_architecture_findings.generation_loop: Iterative Top-K Confidence-Based Unmasking across num_step=4 timesteps
teacher_architecture_findings.vocoder: Higgs Vocoder (1D Conv, Transposed Conv, Snake1d activations, 24kHz waveform output)
teacher_architecture_findings.training_loss: Layer-weighted Cross-Entropy over discrete audio codebook vocabulary

method_a_progressive_unmasking_distillat.mechanism: Train student to predict the combined unmasked tokens of 2 teacher steps in a single step (4 -> 2 -> 1 steps)
method_a_progressive_unmasking_distillat.loss: Cross-Entropy on Teacher-Unmasked Token Trajectories + Masked Cross-Entropy

method_b_confidence_distillation.mechanism: Distill both hard discrete token predictions and soft confidence logits from teacher audio heads to student
method_b_confidence_distillation.loss: KL Divergence on Audio Head Logits + Top-K Ranking Margin Loss

method_c_one_step_parallel_predictor.mechanism: Direct 1-step parallel generation of all 8 codebooks from prompt embeddings
method_c_one_step_parallel_predictor.risk: Moderate (May experience acoustic degradation on fast tone transitions)

student_configurations.name: Student A: 2-Step Flow-Distilled Model
student_configurations.risk: Very Low (Maintains high audio fidelity and tone distinctions)

student_configurations.name: Student B: 1-Step Parallel Non-Autoregressive Model
student_configurations.risk: Moderate (Requires strict confidence distillation to prevent phoneme blur)

student_configurations.name: Student C: Compact 14-Layer 2-Step Hybrid Model
student_configurations.risk: High (Requires both layer pruning initialization and distillation)

dataset_evaluation.poc_minimal_dataset: 5 hours clean paired subset from VIVOS
